claims.proof: Axial radius n: shell has six sides of n steps, each corner counted once. Summation yields 1+3n(n+1). Six triangular sectors each contain n² elementary faces.
Two radius-one balls shifted by (1,0) intersect in four vertices; union 10, not 13. Inclusion-exclusion requires full intersection.

Order origin first, then shells by increasing radius and fixed cyclic order. Prefixes realize every positive integer as vertex count; empty prefix realizes zero. This is generic enumeration, not a prediction or physical law.
